scope: Follow-up source review of the 79 EncarRus no-match listing IDs. The 30 candidate listings in this ledger were preflighted against the specified Encar run and imported into draft power references only; they are not approved for calculation or publication.
sourcePolicy: Drom Korean-market specification pages are secondary-source candidates. A candidate is retained only where the run identity and Drom Korean-market year/engine/fuel/drive/trim evidence align in the research notes. This is not legal or TKS confirmation.

countingNote: Within the 79 EncarRus no-match IDs: 14 listings from v1 plus these 30 listings have draft power evidence imported, for 44 listings across 36 configurations.
